name: extract_intake_details
description: Capture the opening details: `{{inbound_channel}}`, `{{interest_topic}}` (their words, APPEND if more than one), `{{pain_frame}}`. Call it ONCE, when all three are captured.

variables.name: inbound_channel
variables.description: How the prospect heard about Dialux (voicemail, cold outreach, Indeed job post, Facebook/Meta ad, search, other)

variables.name: interest_topic
variables.description: What caught their attention, in their exact words. APPEND if more than one — never replace.

variables.name: pain_frame
variables.description: The angle that worries them — why they started looking right now

name: intake_completed
description: Set intake_completed to true ONLY after: When how they heard about us, what caught their attention, and what's worrying them are all captured. Do not set it early.

variables.name: intake_completed
variables.description: true ONLY after: When how they heard about us, what caught their attention, and what's worrying them are all captured.
